entries.text: ESP32 projects can use GPIO, PWM, ADC, I2C, SPI, UART, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.
Common IoT flow: sensor -> microcontroller -> processing -> network -> dashboard or actuator.
I2C commonly uses SDA and SCL lines and device addresses; always check the hardware documentation.
PWM can control LED brightness, motor speed or servo-related signals depending on hardware.
MicroBlocks uses visual blocks to control compatible boards and is useful for rapid hardware experiments.
Arduino sketches commonly contain setup and loop functions and use libraries for sensors and displays.
